annotations.title: Design new versions of a page

description: Generate visual design directions for an existing audit when requested. Use check_balance for page coverage and follow the user's permission. Returns a run to resume with get_concepts; show the images already available before asking the user to choose. Never start a build without their choice.

count.description: How many distinct directions the user wants, up to 12. Leave it out for the standard pack of 2. Check returned page coverage before starting more work. Directions that already exist are counted and reused.

direction.description: Optional plain-English creative steer. Honoured above other design choices.
